items.title: Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal PC remaster
items.content:
A native PC version of Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal (PS2, 2004), built from the game's own code. The disc's code is translated ahead of time and runs on this project's own runtime and renderer, not in an emulator. You need your own disc image of the USA release (SCUS-97353). The launcher asks for the .iso once and checks it. New on PC: widescreen at your screen's shape with a field-of-view option, high frame rates, keyboard and mouse with mouse aiming, Xbox and DualSense controllers with their own button prompts, and a PC settings page inside the game's own menus. Optional updated textures add new surface detail lit per pixel, alongside ambient occlusion, water reflections and light shafts. On NVIDIA RTX cards there's ray-traced lighting and reflections, with DLSS and frame generation. The full single-player story is here; multiplayer isn't included yet. Updated textures (optional, about 12 GB) The remaster's own textures: 4,990 surfaces across 1,134 new materials, each with surface grain, normal-mapped relief and gloss, lit per pixel. Two community packs come with them: reddyxd and nerus's HD texture pack, and TexMaster's PAL pack, which fills the gaps. To install, download the seven updated-textures volumes (.7z.001 to .7z.007) from the v0.1.0 release: https://github.com/sneid1/ratchet3-pc-remaster/releases/tag/v0.1.0. Open the first one with 7-Zip and extract everything into the game's folder, where uya.exe is. The game finds them by itself. Without them, it plays with the original PS2 textures. GRAPHICS > UPDATED TEXTURES sets how much of them is used. At full size they take about 4 GB of graphics memory. AUTO, the default from v0.1.9, picks the level your graphics card can hold.

For PlayStation 2. Runs on Windows. By sneid1.

Crispy Hexen is a limit-removing enhanced-resolution Hexen source port based on Chocolate Doom.

For PC. Runs on Windows, macOS. By Fabian Greffrath.

items.title: Crispy Doom – Heretic
items.content:
Crispy Heretic is a limit-removing enhanced-resolution Heretic source port based on Chocolate Doom.

For PC. Runs on Windows, macOS. By Fabian Greffrath.

items.title: Crispy Doom
items.content:
Crispy Doom is a limit-removing enhanced-resolution Doom source port based on Chocolate Doom.

For PC. Runs on Windows, macOS. By Fabian Greffrath.

items.title: SanctuaryPort – Diablo III: Eternal Collection
items.content:
SanctuaryPort is a native PC port of Diablo III: Reaper of Souls Ultimate Evil Edition for PlayStation 4 that supports local co-op and Xbox button icons.

For PlayStation 4. Runs on Linux, Windows. By CaduGimenes.

items.title: NascarThunder2004Recomp – NASCAR Thunder 2004
items.content:
NascarThunder2004Recomp is a static recompilation of NASCAR Thunder 2004 for Windows, macOS, and Linux that runs in a web browser and includes a launcher for setting up rosters, teams, and careers.

For Xbox. Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows. By Boomhower34.

items.title: CAB2 – Crazy Taxi 2
items.content:
CAB2 is a native Windows port of Crazy Taxi 2 for the Sega Dreamcast, featuring widescreen support and keyboard/XInput controls.

For Sega Dreamcast. Runs on Windows. By Thiago86.

items.title: Chocolate DOOM-3-BFG – Doom 3: BFG Edition
items.content:
Chocolate DOOM-3-BFG is a source port of Doom 3: BFG Edition for Windows and Linux that aims to accurately reproduce the original experience with bug fixes and performance optimizations.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By klaussilveira.

items.title: Looking Glass – American McGee's Alice
items.content:
Looking Glass is a PC port of American McGee's Alice that allows playing the full campaign with guided setup and controller support.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By looking-glass-project.

items.title: libRealSpace – Strike Commander
items.content:
libRealSpace is a cross-platform open-source recreation of the RealSpace engine for Strike Commander and Wing Commander.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By remileonard.

items.title: LostVikings – The Lost Vikings
items.content:
LostVikings is a native PC port of The Lost Vikings that includes sound rendered by the Nuked core and support for console content packs.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By akaWolf.

items.title: Silent Heritage – Silent Hunter
items.content:
Silent Heritage is a PC and mobile port of Silent Hunter that includes the game and scenario editor with classic and extended versions.

For PC. Runs on Android, Linux, macOS, Windows. By conning-tower.

items.title: F15SE2-RE – F-15 Strike Eagle 2
items.content:
F15SE2-RE is a reconstruction of the MS-DOS game F-15 Strike Eagle 2 aiming for bug-for-bug faithfulness.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By neuviemeporte.

items.title: NFS Recompiled – Need for Speed II: Special Edition
items.content:
nfs-recompiled is a native PC port of Need for Speed II: Special Edition and Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit built from original executables.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By motor-dev.

items.title: OpenOP2 – Outpost 2
items.content:
OpenOP2 is a community PC port of Outpost 2 that runs on Windows, Linux and macOS.

For PC. Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux. By OpenOP2.

items.title: SKProject – Dungeon Master II: The Legend of Skullkeep
items.content:
skproject is a Windows port of the game Skullkeep.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By gbsphenx.

items.title: Signus – Signus: The Artefact Wars
items.content:
Signus is a PC port of the turn-based strategy game Signus: The Artefact Wars.

For PC. Runs on Windows, Linux. By signus-game.

items.title: remc2 – Magic Carpet 2
items.content:
remc2 is a PC port of Magic Carpet 2 The Netherworlds with support for HD resolutions and modern controls.

For PC. Runs on Windows, Linux. By thobbsinteractive.

items.title: Omnispeak – Commander Keen
items.content:
Omnispeak is a reimplementation of Commander Keen in Goodbye Galaxy for PC that is pixel-perfect and includes quicksave/quickload features.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By sulix.

items.title: Wizball (Retrospec Fan Remake)
items.content:
Wizball (Retrospec remake source archive) is a preserved source release of the 2007 Wizball PC/Mac remake, updated to build and run on modern Linux and package for PortMaster handhelds.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By Graham Goring.

items.title: re-Sonic06Demo – Sonic the Hedgehog (2006)
items.content:
re-Sonic06Demo is a PC port of the Sonic The Hedgehog (2006) Demo using the ReXGlue SDK.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By PranchaD.

items.title: SymphonyRecomp — Android – Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
items.content:
SymphonyRecomp — Android is a native Android port of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night that runs the recompiled PlayStation code directly.

For PlayStation, Mobile. Runs on Android. By sergiomanzur.

items.title: Digimon Super Xros Wars Recomp – Digimon Story: Super Xros Wars Red
items.content:
Digimon Super Xros Wars Recomp is a native Windows PC port of Digimon Story: Super Xros Wars Red that runs the original game logic natively with higher-resolution 3D and a settings menu.

For Nintendo DS. Runs on Windows. By aoxzh.

items.title: Dr. Creep – The Castles of Doctor Creep
items.content:
DrCreep is a reimplementation of The Castles of Dr. Creep for Windows with a built-in castle builder.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By segrax.

items.title: stuntcarremake – Stunt Car Racer
items.content:
stuntcarremake is a PC port of Stunt Car Racer Remake that supports dynamic window resizing and font scaling.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By ptitSeb.

items.title: Command Series Engine – Crusade in Europe
items.content:
Command Series engine is a port of the Command Series games for Windows and Linux.

For Commodore Amiga. Runs on Linux, Windows. By pwiecz.

items.title: Gates of Skeldal – Brány Skeldalu
items.content:
Gates of Skeldal is a PC source port of Brány Skeldalu.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By ondra-novak.

items.title: Colditz Escape Source Port
items.content:
Colditz Escape is a rewritten game engine for the Amiga game Escape From Colditz, available on Windows, Linux, and MacOS.

For Commodore Amiga. Runs on Windows, Linux, macOS. By aperture-software.

items.title: Raze – Duke Nukem 3D
items.content:
Raze is a port of Build engine games like Duke Nukem 3D and Blood, combining them using GZDoom technology.

For PC. Runs on Windows, macOS, Linux. By ZDoom + GZDoom teams.

items.title: Eternity Engine – Doom
items.content:
Eternity Engine is a Doom source port for Windows and macOS with high-resolution support and ACS scripting.

For PC. Runs on macOS, Windows. By team-eternity.

items.title: Freeserf – The Settlers
items.content:
Freeserf is a PC port of the game Serf that allows playing with DOS or Amiga data files.

For PC. Runs on Windows, macOS, Linux. By freeserf.

items.title: OpenTDU – Test Drive Unlimited
items.content:
OpenTDU is a PC port of Test Drive Unlimited that fixes issues and adds cross-platform compatibility.

For PC. Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows. By opentestdriveunlimited.

items.title: Diggers Fan Remake
items.content:
Diggers is a fan remake of the Amiga puzzle strategy game Diggers for Windows, macOS and Linux.

For Commodore Amiga. Runs on macOS, Windows. By Mhatxotic.

items.title: igor – Igor: Objective Uikokahonia
items.content:
Igor: Objetivo Uikokahonia is a PC port of Igor: Objetivo Uikokahonia for Windows and Android.

For PC. Runs on Windows, Android. By cyxx.

items.title: cyrus – The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard
items.content:
Cyrus is a PC port of The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard built in Rust and Bevy.

For PC. Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux. By michidk.

items.title: JSettlers – The Settlers 3
items.content:
JSettlers is a Java remake of The Settlers 3 for PC and Android.

For PC, Mobile. Runs on Android, Windows. By paulwedeck.

items.title: Bedlam 2: Absolute Bedlam (Source Port)
items.content:
Bedlam 2: Absolute Bedlam is a PC port of Bedlam 2: Absolute Bedlam with SDL support, various screen resolutions, and bug fixes.

For PC. Runs on Windows, Linux. By 8street.

items.title: ironseed_fpc – Iron Seed
items.content:
ironseed_fpc is a PC port of the 1994 DOS science-fiction game Iron Seed, allowing it to run on GNU/Linux with ongoing bug fixes.

For PC. Runs on Linux. By mnalis.

items.title: shin – Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku ~Nekobako to Musou no Koukyoukyoku~
items.content:
shin is a port of the Entergram visual novel engine for Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku ~Nekobako to Musou no Koukyoukyoku~.

For Nintendo Switch. Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux. By DCNick3.

items.title: Yakuza — PC Port

Yakuza — PC Port is a native PC port of Yakuza for Windows and Linux with 60 FPS, high resolution, and an over-the-shoulder camera.

For PlayStation 2. Runs on Windows, Linux. By Ivan Barbosa Filho.

items.title: NorseWorld-Ragnarok – Valhalla
items.content:
NorseWorld-Ragnarok is a PC port of the roguelike game NorseWorld: Ragnarok, featuring randomly generated worlds and six player classes.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By Sergey Zhdanovskih.

items.title: Lilium Voyager – Star Trek: Voyager - Elite Force

For PC. Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows. By Clover.moe.

items.title: Diamonds
items.content:
Diamonds is a PC port of the Breakout-style game where players clear blocks by bouncing a ball.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By mblaine.

items.title: Crash Team Racing: High Octane
items.content:
Crash Team Racing: High Octane is a sourceport of Crash Team Racing for Windows, featuring 60 FPS support, true widescreen, and post-processing effects.

For PlayStation Portable, PC. Runs on Windows. By Rinnegatamante.

For PC. Runs on Windows, Android, macOS, iOS. By XProger.

items.title: FreeRCT – RollerCoaster Tycoon

items.content:
Amnesia: The Dark Descent — Redux is a port of Amnesia: The Dark Descent that replaces the OpenGL renderer with Vulkan and uses Slang shaders.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By OSS-Cosmic.

items.title: Puzzle Moppet
items.content:
Puzzle Moppet is a port of the 3D puzzle game Puzzle Moppet with an integrated level editor.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By karjonas.

items.title: Vib-Ribbon Minus – Vib Ribbon
items.content:
Vib-Ribbon Minus is a 2D remake of Vib-Ribbon for macOS and Windows with support for custom levels and advanced timing mechanics.

For PlayStation. Runs on Windows, macOS. By PlayNowKnux.

items.title: l'Abbaye des Morts (SDL2)
items.content:
l'Abbaye des Morts (SDL2) is a PC port of the indie game l'Abbaye des Morts using C and SDL2 libraries with OpenGL rendering and auto-scaling.

For PC, Wii, PlayStation Portable, Xbox, Nintendo DS. Runs on Linux. By nevat.
